 John-Austin Saviano – Emerging Managers and IC Governance (Capital Allocators, EP.294) 
 
 John-Austin Saviano – Emerging Managers and IC Governance (Capital Allocators, EP.294) Jan 30, 2023

 John-Austin Saviano is the founder of High Country Advisors,
where he serves as a strategic advisor to both investment firms and
the institutional pools of capital that back them. Before starting
High Country in 2017, John-Austin served as an allocator for nearly
two decades at the Moore Foundation, Cambridge Associates, and as
the first CIO of UC-Berkeley's Endowment.

Our conversation covers John-Austin's career path from direct
investing to allocation and insights gleaned across his roles. We
then turn to his work at High Country, including lessons he shares
with emerging managers to help tell their story and navigate a
difficult fund-raising environment and those he shares with
allocators about governance and investment committees.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
